blurb: An embed becomes a `String` in the compiled code, so its file must be text. A file holding a NUL byte is binary, and a `String` made from it would be meaningless. Binary data belongs in `assets/`, where the platform serves it as a file. Text that is not valid UTF-8 is `bynk.embed.invalid_encoding`.
example:
embed logo = "embeds/logo.png"    // ✗ the file has a NUL byte

asset logo = "assets/logo.png"    // ✓ a binary file is served, not read
summary: An `embed` names a file with a NUL byte, so it is binary, not text.
